class.name: Enemy
class.description: Enemy is a class that is designed to be inherited. Initialization logic will be called at the end of [method _enter_tree] via the [method _init_logic] virtual function. Per tick behaviour can be controlled with the [method _ai_tick] virtual function, which is called once per AI tick by the [AiManager].

method.name: _init_logic
method.description: Called at the end of [method _enter_tree]. Override this to use custom initialization logic.

method.name: _ai_tick
method.description: Called on each AI tick. Every [code]1/manager.interval[/code] by the [AiManager][code]manager[/code]. Used to update target. Override for custom AI logic.

method.name: _physics_process
method.description: Called on each Physics Tick. Used to move the Enemy, and smoothly rotate towards the next position on the navmesh.

method.name: print_type
method.description: Print the type of the variant.

members.member: Reference to the [MousePosNode] that the Enemy will target.
Reference to the [NavigationAgent3D] that the Enemy uses to navigate.
